units: <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 5:16">Tosef. Toh. V, 16</cite> <he>הרוֹטֶה פשתנו</he> (ed. Zolk. <he>הרוטב</he>) he who wets (squirts) his flax (to make it soft for spinning).

<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 4:11">Ib. IV, 11</cite> <he>אף הרוֹטֵיהוּ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הסוטיהו</he>, corr. acc.; ed. Zolk. <he>הרטיבין</he>, read: <he>הרוֹטְבוֹ</he>) he who wets it (the flax spun by a menstruant) is likewise unclean on account of his mouth (coming in contact with it through the medium of the liquid in squirting).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 21">Ex. R. s. 21</cite> <he>ה׳ אותי בידו</he> he caused me to be wrong out in his (Satan’s) hand (with ref. to <he>יִרְטֵנִי</he>, <cite ref="Job 16:11">Job XVI, 11</cite>).
